“[Name], Victorious Wisdom Buddha, Good [Name] Buddha, Well-Seen Buddha, Vaiḍūrya Banner Buddha, [Name] Buddha...”

“Those who single-mindedly take refuge in and pay homage to the Buddha Brahmā-rāja shall eliminate the sins of birth and death for thirty thousand six hundred kalpas.
Those who single-mindedly pay homage to the Buddha Anivartana-cakra-śirṣa shall eliminate the sins of birth and death for one thousand koṭis of kalpas.”
"Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Mahāprabha shall eliminate the karmic offenses of birth and death for eighty-six thousand kalpas.
Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Dharmagotravara shall eliminate the karmic offenses of birth and death for four hundred and nine kalpas."
"Siddhartha Buddha, Prabhāsa Buddha, Dharmagotra-guru Buddha, Ratnagarbha-vyūha Buddha—
these are the names of one hundred and fifty Buddhas currently residing in the southern direction."
The Buddha said:

"If good sons or good daughters, upon hearing the names of the Buddhas of the southern quarter, do not harbor doubts or fetters, but believe in and awaken to the eye of the Way, upholding these names and prostrating themselves, they shall be fully endowed with merit in the present life and attain five dharmas:
first, the elimination of the notion of self, and the constant encounter with the era of a Buddha;"
Second, they shall attain the exalted power of a wheel-turning sage king;
third, they shall obtain *dhāraṇī*, master the scriptures, and possess immeasurable sincerity and faith;
fourth, they shall perfect the thirty-two marks of a great man and fully complete all practices until the attainment of the Buddha-way.
Fifth, they will ultimately attain the five supernormal powers (*pañcābhijñā*) without any obstruction or hindrance;
these are the five matters.

If there is a woman who hears this Buddha’s name and pays homage with a sincere heart, she will leave behind her female body and be reborn in a pure buddha-field, fully endowed with supernormal powers, and able to eliminate the karmic offenses of birth and death for seven hundred trillion *kalpas*.

“Vṛkṣamūlapuṣparāja Buddha and Candanamaṇiprabha Buddha.
These are the names of one hundred and fifty Buddhas currently residing in the southwestern direction.
The Buddha addressed Śāriputra:

"If any sons or daughters of good family hear the names of these Tathāgatas, they must have already made offerings to the Buddhas of the past; they should, with single-minded faith and joy, uphold and recite them. They shall transcend the vast and immeasurable, establish their minds in joyful peace, and through a heart of millions of faithful delights, bring the Tathāgatas to mind. Such persons shall obtain immeasurable merit, forever remain far removed from the calamities of the three evil realms, and after the end of their lives, all shall be reborn in those Buddha-fields."

At the time of their death, those Tathāgatas, accompanied by their great assemblies, will stand before those individuals, preaching the Dharma and teaching them so that they do not regress and shall certainly attain perfect enlightenment.

If there are those who, upon hearing the names and the praise of the virtues of these Tathāgatas, give rise to slander, they shall fall into hell and undergo all manner of sufferings for one million five hundred thousand kalpas; however, if there are those who receive and uphold [these names] with single-minded devotion, never abandoning them, and offer prostrations and worship, they will extinguish the sins of birth and death accumulated over ten trillion kalpas.

The Buddha said:

"If there are good men or good women who study the Bodhisattva path and, upon hearing these names of the Buddhas, do not give rise to a web of doubt, but instead believe with sincerity and serve them with reverence, they will, wherever they are born, attain the Samādhi of Radiant Manifestation and immediately thereafter achieve the gates of immeasurable samādhis."

At the time of death, one shall also behold ten billion *kai* Buddhas and Perfectly Awakened Ones in each of the ten directions; from all of them, one shall be able to receive and accept the most profound words of Dharma, never again forgetting them until the attainment of the Buddha-way, and shall be able to repel the sins of birth and death for a thousand kalpas, forever casting them away and no longer receiving them.

The Buddha Amitābha.
These are the names of one hundred and fifty Buddhas currently residing in the northwest.”
The Buddha told Ajita:

"If sons or daughters of good family hear the names of these Tathāgatas and, with faith, joy, and delight, receive, uphold, recite, and pay homage to them, they have already made offerings to and beheld five hundred thousand Buddhas."

In whatever place such a person is born, they will always possess the divine eye to see the lands of the ten directions and always possess the divine ear to hear immeasurable sounds. Their body will be able to fly as they attend upon all Buddhas, and their mind will always be able to know the thoughts of all beings. Until they reach Nirvana, they will never be born into lowly or impoverished circumstances, nor will they be born in the three evil realms or the eight difficult conditions. Their body will be like a diamond, endowed with the various marks and signs of excellence; their mind will delight in the Great Dharma and be loved and respected by all; and in every successive rebirth, they will never be separated from the Buddhas.
Therefore, Ajita!

As for those who reverently pay homage to the names of the Buddhas, the merit they obtain can only be known by a Buddha; they shall forever be liberated from the sins of birth and death throughout thousands of myriads of koṭis of kalpas.

If one hears the names of these Buddhas—Guṇāntarābharaṇavyūha Buddha—and with joy, faith, and delight recites and remembers them, single-mindedly prostrating in worship, one shall attain non-retrogression, swiftly achieve perfect enlightenment, and eliminate one kalpa of birth and death. In future lives, one shall obtain the six supernormal powers and physical perfection; one shall always be noble and honored, able to sever the bonds of desire, and the six sense-faculties shall always be free from illness. One shall always be born in the presence of Buddhas, hear the Dharma, and see the Saṃgha; one shall be freed from the eight difficulties, always maintain pure precepts, and have an undisturbed mind until reaching Nirvāṇa.

“If one hears the name of the Buddha Vajradṛḍhavināśanasaṃkramaṇavikramin, rejoices with faith and delight, and recites it with mindfulness, one will attain non-retrogression and eliminate the sins of ten trillion kalpas.”
“By hearing the name of the Buddha Ratnāgni, one who rejoices with faith and delight, recites and contemplates it, shall attain non-retrogression and swiftly achieve perfect enlightenment.

By hearing the name of the Buddha Ratnacandraprabha, one who believes, delights in, upholds, recites, and contemplates it, shall subsequently attain right concentration and personally behold all Buddhas turning the sublime wheel of Dharma.”

"If one hears the name of the Buddha Bhadraśreṣṭha, rejoices with gladness, and joyfully upholds, recites, and contemplates it, they will be born handsome in their next life, remember their past lives, and attain perfect enlightenment."

“If one hears the name of the Buddha Ratnapadmapratiṣṭhita, believes in him with joy, and recites and remembers it, wherever they are born, they shall be honored by all and their words and teachings shall be accepted.
Those who single-mindedly pay homage to him can cause women to become men and attain the stage of *avaivartika*.”

The Buddha told Śāriputra:

"If sons or daughters of good family hear the names of these Buddhas and, with joy, faith, and delight, recite, venerate, and pay homage to them, the merit they obtain shall surpass all other merits, including those from all acts of giving, by a factor of ten trillion. They shall be reborn at will in the lands of all Buddhas and shall attain unexcelled, perfect enlightenment without falling back."
If there are those who slander, harbor doubts, or lack faith, they shall fall into the Vaitaraṇī Hell and undergo immeasurable suffering for sixty trillion years;

"To those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Who Severs Doubt, Uproots Desire, and Dispels Darkness, thirty-six billion kalpas of the retribution for birth and death shall be eliminated.

To those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Whose Mind Is Fearless and Whose Body Hairs Do Not Stand on End, eighty thousand kalpas of the retribution for birth and death shall be eliminated."
“Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Siṃha shall eliminate the offenses of birth and death for sixty kalpas.
Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Yaśas-kīrti-dūra-śruta shall eliminate the offenses of birth and death for eighty thousand kalpas.”
“Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha named Dharmākhyāna shall eliminate the offenses of birth and death for seventy-two kalpas.
Those who single-mindedly pay respectful homage to the Buddha Dharma will eliminate the offenses of birth and death for eight million two hundred and thirty thousand kalpas.”
"To those who single-mindedly pay homage to the Buddha Dharmadhvaja, the offenses of birth and death for one hundred twenty-three trillion kalpas shall be eliminated.
[So too for] the Buddha Śāntapraśāntacandrarāja, the Buddha Vimalaprabha, and the Buddha Sūryacandraprabharāja."
"Names of One Thousand Five Hundred Buddhas of the Ten Directions," one scroll. Completed on the fifteenth day of the ninth month of the first year of the Jiande era.
